style: Photorealistic rugged coastal headland at sunset, a white and blue passenger ferry crossing a deep blue strait in front of a long island on the horizon, rocky cliffs and coastal shrubs in the foreground, gum leaves at the upper left
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.
ambience: Wind over a headland and surf on rocks below

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: Swells roll through the strait and break white against the rocks below throughout the shot. The ferry keeps its shape and glides slowly to the right trailing a white wake, clouds drift slowly to the left, and the coastal grasses bend in the wind. The cliffs, the rocks and the island stay still.
